users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Accounts for administrators, teachers and parents.
users.deactivateBody: They will be signed out and won't be able to sign in until you activate the account again. Nothing is deleted.
users.createHint: Share the sign-in details with the person in a safe way.
users.identifierHint: Used to sign in. Letters, numbers and . _ - @ only.
users.identifierFixed: The sign-in name can't be changed.
users.identifierInvalid: Enter an email address or a username (letters, numbers and . _ - @).
users.identifierTaken: Someone already uses this email or username.
users.selfRoleHint: You can't change your own role.
users.roleChangeHint: The person will be signed out, and their class assignments or child links from the old role are removed.
users.selfBlocked: You can't change your own role or deactivate your own account.
users.resetPasswordHint: The person will be signed out on all devices and will need the new password.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Kindergarten classes and the teachers who work with them.
classes.emptyHint: Create a class, then choose its teachers.
classes.name: Class name
classes.kindergartenHint: Choose an existing kindergarten or type a new name.
classes.duplicate: This kindergarten already has a class with this name.
classes.teachersHint: Teachers see the children of their classes right away.
classes.noTeachers: There are no teacher accounts yet. Add one on the Users page.
classes.noChildren: No children in this class yet.
classes.childrenUnavailable: The children list isn't available yet.
classes.deleteBody: The class and its teacher assignments will be removed.
classes.deleteBlocked: This class still has children. Move them to another class first.

parents.title: Parent accounts
parents.subtitle: Linked parents can see their child's basics and the activities you share with them.
parents.none: No parent account is linked yet.
parents.linkHint: Only parent accounts can be linked.
parents.noAccountYet: The parent has no account yet?
parents.unlinkBody: They will no longer see this child. Their account stays active.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organization, AI and report settings for everyone.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Your organization and the default languages.
general.uiLanguageHint: Used for new users when no language is chosen.
general.contentLanguageHint: The language of new activities, unless the teacher picks another.

ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: How activities and suggestions are drafted. Teachers always review the drafts.
ai.modeClaudeHint: Uses Claude when an API key is available; otherwise the built-in templates.
ai.modeTemplateHint: Always uses the built-in templates. Nothing is sent to an AI service.
ai.keyFromServer: No key saved here. The server key is used.
ai.keyNone: No key saved. The built-in templates are used.
ai.keyReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new key to replace it
ai.keyInvalid: The key should start with sk-ant-.

testErrors.AI_NO_KEY: There is no key to test. Save a key first.
testErrors.AI_AUTH: The key was not accepted. Check it and try again.
testErrors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: This model is not available for the key.
testErrors.AI_TIMEOUT: The service took too long to answer. Try again.
testErrors.AI_BAD_REQUEST: The service could not handle the request. Check the model.
testErrors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The service cannot be reached right now. Try again later.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: What PDF reports show in the header and footer.
reports.footerNoteHint: Optional, up to 300 characters. Printed on every page.
reports.disclaimerNote: The standard disclaimer is always printed at the bottom of every page, whatever you write here.

ai.title: AI engines
ai.subtitle: Each AI capability and the provider that powers it. Providers are connected later; until then an engine reports it is not set up.
ai.mockMode: Mock mode is on: engines without a provider answer with built-in test data. Never use mock mode in production.
ai.footnote: Usage and estimated cost cover the last 30 days. Secrets are never shown: an engine names the AI_CRED_* server variable that holds its key.
ai.recentHint: Metadata only: what each request asked is never listed here.
ai.childFacing: Its results can reach children: they are always checked with the strict safety rules and need the teacher's approval.

fields.providerHint: The adapters installed on the server.
fields.credentialsHint: The name of the server environment variable that holds the key, starting with AI_CRED_.
fields.credentialsMissing: The server variable is not set yet.
fields.costHint: Optional. Requests stop for the day when the estimate reaches it.

hints.reasoning: General reasoning, analysis and decision support.
hints.child_understanding: Turns questionnaires, observations and the teacher observation into a structured picture of strengths, interests and needs.
hints.observation_analysis: Categorizes teacher observations and finds possible patterns and changes over time.
hints.recommendation: Suggests goals, activities, content and next steps for the teacher.
hints.content_generation: Creates activities, exercises, learning materials, teacher resources and game definitions.
hints.story: Writes personalized children's stories in the child's language and interests.
hints.character: Creates characters and keeps their look and voice the same everywhere.
hints.image_generation: Illustrations, educational cards and visual materials.
hints.video_animator: Turns scripts and stories into animated videos with scenes, characters and narration.
hints.speech_recognition: Speech-to-text for the teacher and, where appropriate, the child.
hints.music: Background music, educational songs and story music.
hints.vision: Describes images and extracts visual information.
hints.embedding: Semantic search, similarity and content retrieval.
hints.classification: Classifies observations, skills, interests and content.
hints.translation: Arabic, Hebrew and English, with room for more languages.
hints.safety_moderation: Reviews child-facing results before anyone sees them, on top of the built-in safety check.
hints.personalization: Adapts approved content to the child's interests, strengths and language.
hints.progress_analysis: Looks at observations and activities over time and writes insights for the teacher.
hints.orchestration: Plans which engines handle a request and in which order.
